title: Group rows in a list

blocks.text: IonList groups list rows. IonItem supplies row layout, and IonLabel holds its text.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.code:
import {IonApp,IonPage,IonHeader,IonToolbar,IonTitle,IonContent,IonList,IonItem,IonLabel} from "@ionic/react";
export default function App(){return <IonApp><IonPage><IonHeader><IonToolbar><IonTitle>Reading club</IonTitle></IonToolbar></IonHeader><IonContent className="ion-padding"><IonList><IonItem><IonLabel>Moon Trip</IonLabel></IonItem><IonItem><IonLabel>Garden Days</IonLabel></IonItem></IonList></IonContent></IonPage></IonApp>;}

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not add click behaviour to every row unless it actually performs an action. Keep static rows simple.
